claim.claim-text: 1. A method (200) comprising:

in response to the value of N equal to the first number and an initial transmission of the first number of code block groups, the HARQ-ACK codebook for the initial transmission of the first number of code block groups comprises N HARQ-ACK bits with each bit of the N HARQ-ACK bits corresponding to one code block group of the initial transmission of the first number of code block groups based on decoding result of the code block group and concatenated in ascending order of indices of the first number of code block groups; in response to the value of N being larger than the first number and an initial transmission of the first number of code block groups, the HARQ-ACK codebook for the initial transmission of the first number of code block groups comprises N HARQ-ACK bits with each bit of the first M bits of the N HARQ-ACK bits corresponding to one code block group of the first number of code block groups based on decoding result of the code block group and concatenated in ascending order of indices of the first number of code block groups, and then appended by (N-M) padded bits, wherein the value of M is equal to the first number.

2. The method (200) of claim 1, further comprising: in response to retransmission of the first number of code block groups, the HARQ-ACK codebook for the retransmission of the first number of code block groups comprises N HARQ-ACK bits with each bit of the first M bits of the N HARQ-ACK bits corresponding to one code block group of the retransmission of the first number of code block groups based on decoding result of the code block group and concatenated in ascending order of indices of the first number of code block groups, and then appended by (N-M) padded bits, wherein the value of M is equal to the number of actually retransmitted code block groups of the first number of code block groups.
3. The method (200) of claim 1, wherein the (N-M) padded bits include parity check bits of the first number of HARQ-ACK bits.
4. The method (200) of claim 1, wherein the (N-M) padded bits include a portion of cyclic redundancy check bits of the first number of HARQ-ACK bits.
